text:
tasha: Heads-up 1: Im preparing a docs PR to tighten up Dedicated provisioning examples: add Ruby + Java SDK snippets, clarify isolation semantics, and fix a couple of internal links. Planning to rename `max_batches` -> `max_concurrent_batches` and `burst_limit` -> `burst_capacity` in examples. PR will include migration notes.

ev an: @tasha I can own the Java snippet and the API changelog entry. Do we want the Java example to show async callback handling for preemption?

leo: Ill take Ruby and the provisioning crosslinks. Also will change "eviction" -> "preemption" across Dedicated docs. Small ask: add a sentence calling out that strict isolation disables burst by default.

pri ya: I'll review wording for the SLA table and make the recommended phrasing: "Burst capacity is opportunistic and is not included in committed SLA. Strict isolation may cause preemption and fallback routing." Keep it concise.

docs-bot: link-checker: dedicated/provisioning.md -> broken anchor at line 198: `#capacity_isolation` (underscore). Suggested: `#capacity-isolation`.

tasha: thanks bots. I'll update anchors and add redirect note in the overview doc. Also adding frontmatter `migration: yes` since there are config renames.

evan: Draft Java snippet (will push with language tag):
```java
// create scale policy with concurrency and isolation
ScalePolicy policy = new ScalePolicy.Builder()
  .name("steady-batch")
  .maxConcurrentBatches(6)
  .targetLatencyMs(150)
  .isolationLevel(IsolationLevel.BALANCED)
  .build();
client.dedicated().createScalePolicy(policy, resp -> {
  // handle response or preemption events via event stream
});
```
I'll include a short migration example mapping old field names.

leo: Ruby snippet I'm adding:
```ruby
policy = {
  name: "steady-batch",
  max_concurrent_batches: 6,
  target_latency_ms: 150,
  isolation_level: "balanced",
}
client.dedicated.create_scale_policy(policy)
```
I'll also fix the internal crosslink from /dedicated/overview to provisioning and add a tooltip note about strict isolation disabling burst.

pri ya: small SLA edit suggestion: "Dedicated SLA applies to committed baseline capacity. Opportunistic burst capacity is best-effort and not covered by the baseline SLA; under strict isolation preemption may route requests to pinned fallback models." I'll add this as an inline edit in the PR.

docs-bot: preview build: provisioning.md -> warnings: missing language tag on one code block; broken anchor flagged resolved in branch but crosslink in overview still points to old anchor.

spellcheck-bot: typo-check: change suggested: "behaviour" -> "behavior" in autoscale examples (US English).

tasha: noted. I'll standardize to US English in this doc. Plan: push PR tonight, request reviews from @pri ya and @leo, and then merge after spellcheck passes. Need to coordinate with support so KB aligns with new wording.

evan: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 (Java + changelog).

leo: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/473 (Ruby + anchor fixes + overview redirect).

pri ya: I'll review both tomorrow morning. If all good, we should update the Dedicated migration checklist and console copy to reflect `max_concurrent_batches` and `burst_capacity`. :thumbsup:

tasha: thanks team. Targeting merge before the end of the week so QA and Console copy have time to catch up.
